issues.quote: اصطلاحات رسمی: واژگان حریم خصوصی در INSO 23728
issues.explanation: The section references 'INSO 23728:1403' throughout (title and all six blockquote attributions) but never mentions the equivalent international standard IEEE Std 7002:2022. Evidence I23728-id prints 'Identical with IEEE Std 7002:2022' on the cover. Hard content rule 6 requires both identifiers to be given. If this is the first section of the chapter, the dual identity must be established here; if an earlier introductory section establishes it, this is moot — but the reviewer should verify.
issues.suggested_fix: At first mention in this section (e.g. the opening paragraph), add the dual identifier: «INSO 23728:1403 (معادل یکسان IEEE Std 7002:2022)». Blockquote attributions may remain INSO-only once the equivalence is established.

issues.quote: متن دایره‌های شکل ۱ را عواملی می‌داند که «باید» هنگام شناسایی الزامات سازمانی در نظر گرفته شوند
issues.explanation: The section writes 'الزامات سازمانی' (organizational requirements), dropping 'حریم خصوصی' (privacy). Evidence S23728-029 reads 'الزامات حریم خصوصی سازمانی' (organizational privacy requirements). Although the chapter context is privacy, the omission broadens the scope of the 'shall' statement beyond what the standard says.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'الزامات سازمانی' to 'الزامات حریم خصوصی سازمانی' to match the printed text.
